roles.name: Researcher
roles.description: Runs the AI-led steps with Claude, converts sources, judges synthesis, drafts

roles.name: Research owner
roles.description: Checks TRACES, the pack and the problem space; signs the research pack

roles.name: Senior
roles.description: Checks opportunities, constraints and success outcomes; signs the brief

roles.name: Team lead
roles.description: Leads the engagement day to day; owns the review rhythm and handoffs between stages

roles.name: Context keeper
roles.description: The one role accountable for the Claude project context: uploads only final files, removes replaced versions, owns the stale-check rhythm and says when knowledge is out of date

roles.name: Designer
roles.description: Runs a design session with Claude, decides at the checkpoints; in Explore this is the person in charge of the work

roles.name: Design lead
roles.description: Leads design work in later stages; checks and signs design artefacts

roles.name: Rulebook owner
roles.description: Owns the rulebook and design library in Harden

roles.name: Developer
roles.description: Takes part through the constraints review: tech limits, existing system and integrations

roles.name: Engineer
roles.description: Builds and checks feasibility in later stages

roles.name: Design engineer
roles.description: Bridges design and code (components, tokens) in later stages

roles.name: Second-person checker pool
roles.description: Any person other than the one who ran the step; names go in the read-me
